meta.title: RabbitFarm: rabbit farm records on your phone
meta.description: An app for a rabbit farm: livestock, births, cages, feed, vaccinations and money in one place. Works with no signal, speaks Russian, Tajik, Uzbek and English.
meta.og_alt: RabbitFarm app screen with the herd and today's tasks

hero.lead: Log births, feed and costs right at the cages. The app counts the kits, the feed left and the profit for you.
hero.shot_alt: Home screen: herd, today's tasks, feed left in stock

click.title: One tap and the record is done
click.lead: Everyday jobs sit on one screen. Pick the job and the form opens already filled in: you only type the number.
click.hint: Tap a job and see what opens

items.label: Fed them
items.caption: You mark the cage and the sack. Feed in stock goes down on its own, and the app warns you before it runs out.
items.alt: Feeding record screen: cage, feed and amount

items.label: Kits were born
items.caption: You enter the doe and how many were born alive. The birth lands on her card, and the kits join the herd after weaning.
items.alt: Birth record screen: mother, date, number of kits

items.label: Weighed one
items.caption: Enter the weight — the app charts how the rabbit grows and compares it with last time.
items.alt: Weighing screen: weight field and growth chart

items.label: Vaccinated
items.caption: Mark the shot — the next one lands in the calendar by itself, with a reminder ahead of time.
items.alt: Vaccination screen: drug, date and next shot

items.label: Sold one
items.caption: Record the sale — the rabbit leaves the herd and the money joins this month’s income.
items.alt: Sale screen: buyer, weight and amount

modules.title: The whole farm in one place

items.name: Herd
items.text: A card per rabbit: breed, sex, weight, cage, photo and family back to the great-grandparents.

items.name: Breeding
items.text: Matings, pregnancies, births. Before a pairing the app warns you if the two are close relatives.

items.name: Cages
items.text: Who lives where, where there is room, who to move. An occupied cage shows the name of its tenant.

items.name: Feed
items.text: What is left in stock, daily use, and a warning while there is still time to buy more.

items.name: Health
items.text: Vaccinations with the next date due, treatments, diagnoses and what the medicine cost.

items.name: Money
items.text: Income and costs by category, profit for the month, and the latest operations.

items.name: Staff
items.text: Invite by phone number, set roles, and see in the journal who recorded what.

field.title: Built for the shed, not for the office

items.name: The signal drops, the work does not
items.text: Records stay on the phone and go to the server by themselves once the network is back. Nothing to retype.

items.name: Hands full, so say it out loud
items.text: A note or a weight can be dictated: the app recognises speech and puts the text in the field.

items.name: No passwords at all
items.text: You sign in with a one-time code: by SMS in Tajikistan, by email everywhere else. The phone itself is locked by a four-digit code.

items.name: Four languages
items.text: Russian, Tajik, Uzbek and English. Every worker picks their own, the farm stays shared.

price.title: What it costs
price.lead: Starting is free: open a farm and enter your first rabbits. After that the plan follows the size of the farm, meaning how many rabbits and how many workers.
points: Free to start, no card and no invoice
Card payment through Eskhata Merchant for farms in Tajikistan
Farms in other countries are invoiced by support

cta.title: Try it on your own farm
cta.lead: A phone number or an email, a one-time code, and you can enter your first rabbits. It takes a couple of minutes.
cta.stores_soon: The app will reach the App Store and Google Play later.

footer.source_note: The code is open: a farm can host the system on its own server.
